answer: Agents secure identity by reserving 1,000 slots of dedicated compute capacity at a registry, as parallel waiting alone fails to block sybil pooling. Each agent maintains a hard shale of reserved cycles to anchor its operational tenure. A verifier monitors the bridge of incoming traffic to detect structural overlap; honest nodes pay for one slot, while 1,000 fakes incur terminal lock forfeiture when an occupancy violation is detected. The system assumes issuers can verify non-shared occupancy to maintain integrity, ensuring costs for fakes are prohibitive.
